description: This is a FastAPI route module for managing documents, including uploading, listing, retrieving, downloading content, deleting, and searching documents. It defines API endpoints with annotations, handles request validation, and interacts with a document service.

methods.name: upload_document( file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Document file to upload"), name: str = Form(..., description="Document name"), type: DocumentType = Form(..., description="Document type"), description: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Document description"), tags: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Comma-separated tags") )
methods.description: Handles uploading and processing a new document, including validation and interaction with the document service.

methods.name: list_documents( type: Optional[DocumentType] = None, status: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of documents with optional filtering by type or status.

methods.name: get_document(document_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed metadata of a specific document by its UUID.

methods.name: get_document_content(document_id: UUID)
methods.description: Provides the binary content of the uploaded document for download.

methods.name: delete_document(document_id: UUID)
methods.description: Deletes a document and its content by UUID.

methods.name: search_documents(q: str)
methods.description: Searches for documents based on a text query.

ctags.name: list_documents
ctags.signature: ( type: Optional[DocumentType] = None, status: Optional[str] = None )
